claim_text: Before adding an omega-3 product, the actual daily EPA and DHA amounts from all existing products should be reconciled; total fish-oil mass alone does not indicate EPA+DHA exposure.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support safe assessment of nutrient intake and avoid inappropriate or duplicate supplementation.

population.other_context: People already taking fish-oil or algal omega-3 products; assess label, serving size and frequency.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Food, fortified foods and/or relevant supplement preparations; verify exact product form and label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Omega-3 Health Professional Fact Sheet describes product forms, EPA/DHA content and safety context.
limitations: No additional dose from this claim; dose and indication require separate evidence and safety review.
Source claim and cited underlying studies require full-text appraisal before approval.
